column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 devotion scene / Michette
# offset<TAB>english      The pixel-aware wrapper supplies layout.

column2: You know... I've kind of been...
complaining at you all the time, haven't I...?
Maybe... you've come to hate me...?
You might not remember, but I've always been suuuper selfish...
E-even now... um... you're n-not really... nice to me...
B-but! When you... wouldn't wake up...
even I was a little worried!
B-because, look... you've always taken care of everything around me!
A-and when all that... came down on me...
I thought, maybe it'd be such a huge hassle, or something...!
Of course someone like me... deserves to be hated...!
Hey... wake up...!
Hey... hey, I said!!
There's something I want to tell you!!
I... love your eyes...
When you look at me with those eyes... it feels like some $$記憶$$ I'd forgotten is about to come back...
That's why... why I can't help being so unkind...
The me you always see... isn't the real me!
Hey... You knew all along, didn't you?
You're just getting back at me... because I was mean to you, right?
Say you know how I feel... Say you don't hate me!!
I'm... scared of being betrayed...
So I just can't... talk to people...
But... I don't have parents, or friends... nobody...
Really, I'm lonely... but... I don't want anyone to hate me...
That's why...
S-so... so I made up my mind...
I'd never show anyone... the real me...
I'd live... all alone.
But...
During the ten months... you didn't wake up...
something inside me... just burst open!!
I think I could only let myself depend on someone... when I was with you.
When you look at me...
it feels like feelings I'd forgotten... are about to come back!
Even if everyone hates me... these feelings...
will never, eeeever change!
